title: Zero-Day Rapid Response Mode
goal: Allow instant correlation of breaking zero-days against stored inventory snapshots and trigger immediate override-scans for vulnerable assets.
scope: Threat Intel Feed integration, Inventory Matching logic, and 'Threat Intel' dashboard UI.
generation_reason: Provide immediate value when critical global vulnerabilities (like Log4j) drop, out-pacing offensive AI.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Rapid scans must still respect existing ROE and approval gates.

success_criteria: System matches new CVEs against TechStackProfiles.
UI alerts operator of exposed assets.
One-click 'Scan Now' launches targeted Nuclei tests.

acceptance_criteria: Matches logic correctly identifies stale inventory versions against CVE affected ranges.
